dialogues.speaker: Tepano
dialogues.text: Some Saurians are just too stubborn. The last time someone touched an Iktomisaurus's feathers without permission, they ended up writing a three-page apology!

dialogues.speaker: Tepano
dialogues.text: Who knows if the apology even made sense to the Saurian? But I guess that just goes to show the price of acting on impulse, haha.
